item.title: AI in Education 2026: How Personalized Learning and AI Tutors Are Reshaping Schools
item.description: AI in education is no longer a future scenario — it is already in classrooms, dorm rooms, and living rooms in 2026. Platforms like Khanmigo, Coursera’s adaptive engine, and Duolingo Max are delivering personalized tutoring to millions of students around the world. Yet a 2025 study comparing AI and human tutoring found that AI systems follow predictable response patterns and struggle to adjust in real time, while human tutors scaffold learning through instructional questioning and genuine feedback. The central question for educators, parents, and policymakers in 2026 is not whether to use AI — it is how to use it wisely alongside human teachers.
